nodes.label: Proposed validation and parameter-calibration plan
nodes.rationale: Records a proposal rather than executed work or accepted parameters; sparse executions across exposed development sessions leave selected configuration null.

nodes.label: Eligibility and fill funnel audit
nodes.rationale: Proposes tracing coverage, eligibility, alerts, plans, orders and fills before calibration to distinguish missing data, strategy filters and execution assumptions. Expiry alone does not show a parameter is wrong; entry changes alter the trades entering the portfolio and require exit revalidation.

nodes.label: Chronological selection and untouched holdout
nodes.rationale: Register universe, dates, constraints and precision before inspecting outcomes; account for parameter search and cost/delay sensitivity, freeze a candidate only after development criteria pass, then evaluate once on a later untouched holdout. Insufficient evidence or failed validation leaves the selected configuration empty.

nodes.label: Exposed development leader k1-r2.5-h30
nodes.rationale: The observed leader uses a 1-ATR stop, 2.5 reward multiple and thirty-minute maximum hold, earning $15.45 from three same-day FTFT trades. It is a validation candidate within the existing 27-policy grid, not an approved replacement or independent validation result.

nodes.label: The Probability of Backtest Overfitting
nodes.rationale: Cited as the research basis for accounting for overfitting risk when searching multiple configurations; no additional paper content was inspected during this extraction.
